shots.text: The Ember Reach is a land of volcanoes, and the Emberfolk forge in their heat. Its Warden, Ignar, sleeps in the fire under the mountain of Pyrrhenhall.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Black basalt terraces, lava rivers, glassworks glowing, red and brass banners. Emberfolk at anvils.

shots.text: Ignar had gone mad, and the mountain's fire came out to burn the people it once kept warm. Out of it walked the Herald's army: cinder hounds, smiths sealed in slag, the smoke of burned houses. At its head ran a boy made of embers, the Herald Ashwick. The town of Kethra was first on their road.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Lava spilling out of the slopes of Pyrrhenhall onto the terraces. Out of it walk cinder hounds, slag-armoured smiths and grey smoke-shapes. At their head runs a boy of white embers with a messenger's satchel: Ashwick. Kethra below them.

shots.text:
I'm Fennick. I design the towers; you build them. Those things are made of fire, so fire won't hurt them. Water will. And you, child, will place it where I tell you.

Hold the road to Kethra. Ashwick is somewhere up that mountain. Kill him, and his army loses its head.
shots.speaker: fennick
shots.art_note: Master Fennick, old, spectacles, leather apron, pointing at a tower plan on a cart. Tamsin behind him waving carts of Emberfolk to safety.
